name: split
description: Split offline expense calculator and Capacitor shells

scripts.test: node --test --test-isolation=none tests/core.test.cjs tests/history.test.cjs tests/items.test.cjs tests/reports.test.cjs tests/build.test.cjs tests/native-adapters.test.cjs
scripts.test:browser: node tests/browser.cjs && node tests/accessibility.cjs && node tests/history-browser.cjs && node tests/items-browser.cjs && node tests/navigation.cjs && node tests/share-browser.cjs && node tests/pwa-update.cjs
scripts.android:debug: npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.ios:open: npm run cap:sync && cap open ios
